rationale: No supported optimization applies to this workflow. The job already carries an explicit timeout (timeout-minutes: 60), so the timeout-bounding pattern (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT; measured record experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) is already in place, and the CI history contains only scheduled failures with no representative successful-duration history to justify tightening it (a lower limit risks killing valid slow Playwright runs). There is no matrix, so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply. The uploaded playwright-report artifact is a retained deliverable, so P-LIT-UNUSED-OUTPUTS does not apply. Dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) lacks measured experiment evidence for this workflow, and the existing setup-node cache:npm is mismatched with the yarn-based install; changing it is not backed by the available measured evidence. Build and test coverage is preserved as-is, so no change is warranted.
